title: WebGPU PBR Image-Based Lighting in Rust with wgpu
description: Build PBR image-based lighting in WebGPU with Rust and wgpu using an irradiance cubemap, roughness mip chain, split-sum BRDF LUT, and GGX shading.
imageAlt: Ten gold spheres with changing roughness and metallic reflections across a suspension bridge cubemap.
